info.name: CDR Banking Banking Account Balances Banking Products API

params.name: effective
params.description: Allows for the filtering of products based on whether the current time is within the period of time defined as effective by the _effectiveFrom_ and _effectiveTo_ fields. Valid values are `CURRENT`, `FUTURE` and `ALL`. If absent defaults to `CURRENT`.

params.name: updated-since
params.description: Only include products that have been updated after the specified date and time. If absent defaults to include all products.

params.name: brand
params.description: Filter results based on a specific brand.

params.name: product-category
params.description: Used to filter results on the _productCategory_ field applicable to accounts. Any one of the valid values for this field can be supplied. If absent then all accounts returned.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results to request (standard pagination).

params.name: page-size
params.description: Page size to request. Default is 25 (standard pagination).

items.docs:
